# multipass_alias (Resource)

Creates a host-side alias that executes a command inside a Multipass instance.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "multipass_alias" "ls_workspace" {
  name     = "ls-workspace"
  instance = multipass_instance.dev.name
  command  = "ls -lah /workspace"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Command to execute inside the instance.
- `instance` (String) Target Multipass instance.
- `name` (String) Alias name accessible on the host.

### Optional

- `working_directory` (String) Working directory inside the instance. The command is wrapped with `cd <dir> && exec <command>` automatically.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

An existing alias can be imported by name:

```bash
terraform import multipass_alias.ls_workspace ls-workspace
```
